assay: bulk RNA-seq of immortalized human myotubes (clone 8220), DRAGEN mapping to hg38 + GENCODE v37 quantification
primary_estimand: effect of acute mechanical stretch (in vitro exercise mimic) on gene expression, within each genotype: S-Ctl vs Ctl and S-siLMNA vs siLMNA
planned_contrasts: S-Ctl vs Ctl (Fig. 6d, S3.3.p3; paper: 7 DEGs)
S-siLMNA vs siLMNA (Fig. 6e, S3.3.p3; paper: 634 DEGs = 485 up / 149 down)
non_exercise_contrasts_not_run: siLMNA vs Ctl static (Fig. 3a; 876 DEGs, 446 up / 430 down)
sample_inclusion: n = 4 to 9 samples/group (S2.6.p1); exact samples per comparison not stated
normalization: edgeR CPM; keep genes with CPM > 1 in at least 2 samples (S2.6.p3)
paper_method: DESeq2 v1.34 GLM likelihood ratio test, BH FDR (S2.6.p3)

paper_threshold.source_locator: FIG6 legend d,e (stretch DEGs); S2.6.p3 states |log2FC| > 1 globally

paper_results: Ctl stretch: 7 DEGs; siLMNA stretch: 485 up, 149 down; up genes in cytokine activity, ECM, adhesion; down in HDAC, DNA methylation, contractile fibre; concordant up DEG+DAR: HMGA2, TIMP3, HAS1, COL8A1, PAWR, EMP1; down: CKMT2 (S3.3.p4)
